import type {
  ConfirmationReceiptV1,
  DailyLoopRunV1,
  DeliveryReceiptV1,
  OwnerAuthorityReceiptV1,
  RemoteTranslationReceiptV1,
} from "../src/personal-contracts.js";

export function forgeConfirmation(value: ConfirmationReceiptV1): void {
  value.approval.signature = "forged";
}

export function forgeDelivery(value: DeliveryReceiptV1): void {
  value.approval.signature = "forged";
}

export function forgeOwner(value: OwnerAuthorityReceiptV1): void {
  value.approval.signature = "forged";
}

export function forgeTranslation(value: RemoteTranslationReceiptV1): void {
  value.approval.signature = "forged";
}

export function forgeDaily(value: DailyLoopRunV1): void {
  if (value.receipt !== null) value.receipt.signature = "forged";
}
